facts: The MCP server runs the handlers in its own process and did not make relative paths absolute, so it answered the path as given ("out/mcp.wav"), though the file itself was saved in the right place, the host's directory.
Paths are now made absolute where the caller is, by agent.AbsolutePaths, for the CLI, pipe and the MCP server (app_batch steps included), never in the daemon.
note: 286 alone, checked against the code (schema.go AbsolutePaths; server.go:209; daemon_client.go:90). Fact 1 adds that the file landed right and only the answer was relative. The stored answer cites 100 (the daemon resolving against its own directory), a different defect; 286 itself is clear.
